title: Fire & Smoke Mitigation Rule on Posting Insurance Proceeds
content:
The claims side of the company posts carrier money to Fire & Smoke Mitigation jobs that are billed under a claim file. This rule states which carrier payments may be posted to a fire job, when, how often, and for how much.

## Rule

> The job must be in authorized, cleaning, cleaning complete or invoiced status when insurance proceeds are posted. The carrier payment must be recorded on the same claim file this job is linked to. Only dwelling-coverage payments that reached the company directly or by an endorsed two-party check are posted. A carrier payment is posted to the same fire job at most once. The amount posted is the lesser of the job's balance due and the carrier payment's unapplied remainder after every posting already made from it to any water, fire, mold or rebuild job, in the order of the claim payment allocation rule of the Insurance Claim Services charter.

## Conditions, one by one

| Condition | Read from |
|---|---|
| Job in authorized, cleaning, cleaning complete or invoiced status | the fire job's status |
| Carrier payment recorded on the same claim file this job is linked to | the claim file on the fire job and the claim file on the carrier payment |
| Dwelling-coverage payment that reached the company directly or by an endorsed two-party check | the carrier payment record |
| No earlier posting of this carrier payment to this fire job | the fire job's insurance postings |

All four must hold for a posting. A job in dispatched, closed or cancelled status takes no insurance posting; a carrier payment recorded on a different claim file is not posted to the job; a carrier payment already posted once to this fire job is not posted to it again.

## The amount posted

The amount is the lesser of two figures:

1. the fire job's balance due; and
2. the carrier payment's unapplied remainder, which is the carrier payment less every posting already made from it to any water, fire, mold or rebuild job, in the order of the claim payment allocation rule of the Insurance Claim Services charter.

Hypothetical postings, each from a hypothetical carrier payment of 1000.00:

| Already posted from the carrier payment to other jobs | Unapplied remainder | Fire job balance due | Amount posted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 600.00 | 400.00 | 700.00 | 400.00 |
| 600.00 | 400.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 |
| nothing | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 1000.00 |

## Basis questions

Can a carrier payment posted to one fire job also be drawn on for another job? The rule limits a carrier payment to one posting per fire job; postings to other jobs reduce its unapplied remainder.

Does a carrier payment that the customer still holds as an unendorsed two-party check get posted? Only payments that reached the company directly or by an endorsed two-party check are posted.
